note: Stage 3, second level: the little monkey moves corn. Three teaching scenes — eight corn in the basket plus five on the ground, move two to fill the basket (glow + pack), then split 5 into 2 and 3 in a vertical sum. Answer phase: drag corn to fill then tap the total / listen and pick the matching basket picture / fill the missing split number. No self-answer during the quiz.

lines.text: Look! The little monkey has eight corn in the basket.
And five more corn on the ground.
We move two corn to fill the basket. Now we have ten!
And there are three corn left on the ground.
Ten plus three equals thirteen. Eight plus five equals thirteen!
When we add, we first make a ten, then add the rest.
Seven corn in the basket. Drag some corn to fill the ten-frame.
Eight corn in the basket. Drag some corn to fill the ten-frame.
Nine corn in the basket. Drag some corn to fill the ten-frame.
Six corn in the basket. Drag some corn to fill the ten-frame.
Eight plus five. We split five into two and three.
Nine plus six. We split six into one and five.
Seven plus five. We split five into three and two.
